request.state:
Target: Microsoft (MSFT). Microsoft develops software and cloud services including Windows, Microsoft 365 and Azure, and operates gaming, business-software and related technology businesses.

Focal announcement: Bringing the full power of Copilot to more people and businesses.

Decision cutoff: 2024-01-15T23:59:59-05:00. Only information available before this cutoff is admissible.

Source: Bringing the full power of Copilot to more people and businesses. Published: 2024-01-15. URL: https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2024/01/15/bringing-the-full-power-of-copilot-to-more-people-and-businesses.

Condensed source facts; other details are omitted: As we kick off a new year, we’re thrilled to see people increasingly using and loving Microsoft Copilot for work and life. Our goal is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more by bringing Copilot, the everyday AI companion, to millions of people around the world. Copilot for Microsoft 365 became generally available for enterprises in November. Today we are excited to announce that Copilot for Microsoft 365 is now available for organizations of all sizes — with no seat minimum. Copilot for Microsoft 365 is now generally available for small businesses with Microsoft 365 Business Premium and Business Standard Customers can purchase between one and 300 seats for $30 per person per month.

The exact historical text version is unverified. This is an incomplete source-based reconstruction.

Expectations: No point-in-time analyst consensus or market-implied expectation is available.

No company-wide comparable financial baselines or incremental magnitude inputs were supplied. Do not infer that a large headline amount is material to the target.

The stock showed a substantial past rise over the latest completed session, judged against its recent ordinary variability.

The stock showed a strong past rise over the recent trading week, judged against its recent ordinary variability.

The stock showed a substantial past rise over the recent trading month, judged against its recent ordinary variability.

The stock's recent daily variability was relatively subdued. Variability describes the size of ordinary fluctuations, not their future direction.

The broad market (SPY) showed a very small past rise over the latest completed session, judged against its recent ordinary variability.

The broad market (SPY) showed a substantial past rise over the recent trading week, judged against its recent ordinary variability.

The broad market (SPY) showed a modest past rise over the recent trading month, judged against its recent ordinary variability.

The broad market (SPY)'s recent daily variability was relatively subdued. Variability describes the size of ordinary fluctuations, not their future direction.

Over the recent trading week, the stock showed substantial outperformance relative to the broad market.

Over the recent trading month, the stock showed modest outperformance relative to the broad market.

These are coarse descriptions computed from observed historical inputs. Strong past movement or relative strength is not evidence that the next return must continue or reverse.

The previously fitted market-only reference model favored an upward return beyond the neutral band. Its leading outcome was only slightly favored. It still assigned meaningful possibility to a return inside the narrow neutral band and a downward return beyond the neutral band. This is a training-only model forecast, not an observed outcome or independent news evidence.

The neutral return band's half-width is narrower than the code-computed ordinary five-session variability scale. An irrelevant article does not eliminate ordinary price movement; this is not a calculated class probability.

Forecast target: entry is the first regular-session open after the cutoff; exit is the fifth session close, counting entry as session one. Raw return above +1% is up; within inclusive -1% to +1% is flat; below -1% is down. The initial pre-entry reaction is outside this target.

Do not invent analyst consensus, incremental target sales, new corporate cash payments, or an already-priced news reaction.
